[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
This mod changes the oak tree texture in Stardew Valley. It replaces the original oak tree appearance with a custom design while keeping all in-game functionality unchanged. This is purely a visual retexture and has no impact on gameplay.

[b][size=5]Installation Guide[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the files.[/*]
[*]Add this folder into the Stardew Valley > Mods.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces the default oak tree sprite with a custom texture.[/*]
[*]Uses Content Patcher for safe and compatible asset replacement.[/*]
[*]No changes to gameplay mechanics or balance.[/*]
[*]Lightweight visual retexture mod.[/*]
[/list][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI (latest version recommended)[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list][line]
